description.content:
Get a specific deal with details (basic fields, extra fields, (optionally) custom metadata fields, participants, products, published feedback responses, and full feedback transcript. Make sure the header is set with a key value pair being Key: x-api-token Value: (api token provided from the settings section within the Clozd application).
 - :program_id is required, you can get the program id from the settings page within the Clozd app. 
 - :deal_id is required, see /programs/:program_id/deals to get a paged list of program deals.
